chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Bint Ilyas, from Dawud ibn Sirhan, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام: concerning
Two men who killed a man—he said: “They are to be killed if the family of the slain wishes, and one blood-money is to be returned to their families.”

key_terms.يُقْتَلَانِ: the two are to be killed in retaliation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if two men jointly kill one person in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the case where two men jointly kill one man. If the heirs of the murdered person choose retaliation, both killers may be put to death, and a single diyah is returned to the families of the killers.
